correctness.rationale: The defining binary quartic is square iff odd mixed coefficients vanish, since characteristic is two. Complementary dual charts admit an odd coefficient unit (c or 1). On the remaining chart the exact ideal is (v(a+c u^2),u+c v^3); elimination and c invertible yield the monic degree-seven quotient. Its free seven-element basis proves relative flatness. The explicit factorization v(v^3+s)^2 for nonzero a and v^7 for a=0 yields every stated local scheme length. Exact symbolic identities were rerun using the packaged verifier.
